top_signals.title: ICE Offers Tanker Derivatives for Route Outside Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. said it would offer tanker derivatives contracts based on a route outside the Strait of Hormuz, as the oil shipping industry’s main benchmark continues to be upended by the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Robotics Startup Hits $1 Billion Unicorn Valuation
top_signals.summary: German robotics startup RobCo has surpassed a $1 billion valuation as investors rally behind physical AI companies. CEO and co-founder Roman Hölzl joins Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie, Anna Edwards, and Guy Johnson on "The Opening Trade" to discuss before returning to San Francisco. (Source: Bloomberg)
